name: d4-locations
description: Locations and opening hours: address, phone, per-day hours with a live open/closed indicator, a keyless OpenStreetMap embed and a directions link, managed from the dashboard. Emits LocalBusiness structured data with openingHoursSpecification, which is what puts a business into local search results and map panels.
clientFacingSummary: Your address and opening hours, kept up to date by you: visitors see whether you are open right now, a map, and a directions link.
